seoTitle: How to Add Products to Google Merchant Center via Sheets
metaDescription: Create a Google Shopping product feed in Merchant Center Next using a synced Google Sheets template with proper attribute formatting.
intro: Listing products on Google Shopping starts with getting your product feed formatted correctly, and Merchant Center Next offers a Google Sheets template to make that easier. This guide covers creating a data source, filling in required attributes like price and image links, and setting up automated syncing.

steps.heading: Create a new data source
steps.body: In Google Merchant Center Next, start a new product data source for your feed.

steps.heading: Choose the Google Sheets template
steps.body: Select the option to generate the official Google Sheets feed template.

steps.heading: Understand required attributes
steps.body: Review the mandatory fields, including ID, title, description, price, and image link, to avoid formatting errors.

steps.heading: Enter your product data
steps.body: Fill in accurate product details and image links for each item in your inventory.

steps.heading: Configure the fetch schedule
steps.body: Set up an automated daily fetch schedule so your feed stays synced with the spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Run the first sync and check for errors
steps.body: Trigger the initial manual sync, then review the processing results and troubleshoot any disapprovals.

faq.question: What attributes are required in the product feed?
faq.answer: Essential attributes include ID, title, description, price, and image link, all of which need to be formatted accurately to avoid errors.

faq.question: Will my feed update automatically after the initial setup?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure an automated daily fetch schedule so Merchant Center pulls updated data from your spreadsheet regularly.

faq.question: What should I do if products get disapproved?
faq.answer: Check the Diagnostics tab in Merchant Center to identify the specific error, then correct the relevant attribute in your spreadsheet.

faq.question: Do I need coding or plugins to use this method?
faq.answer: No, the Google Sheets template approach is designed as a no-code alternative for listing products on Google Shopping.
